name: pr-review-dashboard
description: Builds a section-by-section self-review dashboard for a pull request or a stack of them, and acts on the notes you leave on it

github_client_id.title: GitHub OAuth app client id
github_client_id.description: Client id of a GitHub OAuth app you register, with device flow enabled, that guests sign in with when you share a review. Sharing is refused without it.

allowed_mail.title: Emails allowed into a shared review
allowed_mail.description: Optional comma-separated list, such as alice@acme.com,*@acme.com. Cloudflare then asks guests for an email one-time PIN before the page loads. Needs cloudflared 2026.11 or later.
